text: Fairmont's discovery surfaced more wishes than one migration should try to solve at once -- so this video draws a hard scope line.
In v1: a containerized ingestion service, an elastic compute layer, a managed database, and infrastructure defined entirely as code.
Also in v1: a real cross-cloud backup, fixing the single-room, single-copy risk from the first meeting.
Deferred, not forgotten: predictive spoilage modeling, a farmer-facing app, and a trading dashboard, each logged with a reason.
Next: turning 'reliable and cheaper' into exact, testable numbers.
